text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Hey, jailbreakers! I'm so happy to see you again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よう、
〝脱獄囚〟ども！
嬉しいゼぇ、
また〝会え〟たなァ！？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Wow... You're so persistent, it's creeping me out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ……
しつこすぎ、
引くわー……

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... I don't even know what your 'convenients' are. I've had a criminal record in the past. That's right, that was back when Lord Morgan, the Demon Vice-Commander, was still in the Knights...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くくく……
おメーらの〝都合〟も分からなかァねえよ。
小官も過去にゃ〝前科〟あったからなァ。
そう、
あれはまだ騎士団に、
鬼の副団長モーガン卿がいた頃の話さ……

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Th-There it is! I'll talk to myself when I get the chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
出た！　
隙あらば自分語り！

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Vwaaaaah, it's worse to show an opening.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴぁ～カ、
隙を見せた方が悪りンだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: I don't have anything to say in response. As we're losing the match, we've certainly been taken advantage of and let our guards down. It's just like back then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
返す言葉もないな。
勝負に逸る我々には、
たしかに付け入られて然るべき油断があった。
まるであのときと同じだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: That's right, that was a month ago when I was still an eight-year-old. When I was participating in the children's mock family training at my preschool, I asked for virtual breastfeeding, involving Sparrow, who was leading the way
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
あれはまだ、
ぼくが８歳児だった１ヵ月前の話だ。
かかりつけの保育園で
子供たちの模擬家族演習に参加していた折、
引率で来ていたスズメ君を巻きこんで
仮想授乳を要請したぼくは──

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Wh-What!? Talking back!? This guy's taking advantage of a momentary opening in the officer's defense......doeeeeeeeer......self-assertive power......
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なにっ！　語り返しだと！？
こいつ、
小官の一瞬の隙を衝いて……
ドえれー〝自己主張〟力だ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: That's the point of impact, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
衝撃受けるポイント、
そこでいんすか。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... What's wrong, Sister? Only those who are prepared to be told are allowed to speak. I have the resolve to prolong this story without end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くくく……
どうしたシスター。
語っていいのは、
語られる覚悟のある者だけだぜ？
ぼくにはあるぞ、
この語りを果てしなく長引かせる覚悟がな！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yuni, this isn't good! There's a green watchman with glasses shining over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ユニ先輩まずいです！
向こうで緑の監視員が眼鏡を光らせてます！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Why does she pop up everywhere?
text_block_list.orig_text: なんで何処にでも湧くの、あの人。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Tch, I have no choice but to stop here for today. Chloe, Chiel, finish this quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
やむを得ん、
今日はこのぐらいで勘弁してやる。
クロエ君
チエル君、
手早く片付けてしまいなさい。
